semantics.mechanism: A sharp move (high |ROC|) that then STALLS (ROC magnitude shrinks) signals exhaustion; fade it. Loser = late momentum chasers.
semantics.signal_reason: Onset of acceleration (|ROC3|>k) together with a stall (current |ROC| < prior |ROC|); enter next open against the exhausted move.

entry.description: Fresh onset of a 3-bar-ROC acceleration (>0.004) followed by a stall (shrinking magnitude); always fades the up-move.

exit.description: 24-bar time-stop (frozen engine's own exit=time convention); no price target.
